acceptance.rule_basis: ceil(112/124 * population positives) and floor(5/36 * population negatives)

policy.instruction: Given a user's request to a local computer assistant, retrieve the catalog operation whose complete effect matches the request. Partial, related, or sibling operations are not relevant.
policy.threshold_source: P(yes) midpoint of the official yes/no scoring head

stop_rule: Run V61 synthetic. If either gate fails, reject without V62 or fresh. Do not fit a new threshold on this holdout.
